name: Serply
description: Google web, news and Scholar search from any AI agent via the Serply API. 3 tools, API-key auth.
instructions:
This connector wraps the Serply REST API (api.serply.io), which returns Google search results as JSON.

**Setup**:
1. Create an account at https://serply.io (2,500 free credits, no card required) and copy the API key from the dashboard.
2. Set `SERPLY_API_KEY`.

**Authentication**: the key is sent as the `X-Api-Key` header on every call, so it never appears in a logged URL.

**Three tools, two endpoints**:
- `serply_search` - Google web search, `GET /v1/search`. Returns organic hits under `results[]` (`title`, `link`, `description`), plus `answers`, `knowledge_graph` and `related_questions` when Google shows them.
- `serply_news` - the same endpoint with Google's news vertical (`tbm=nws`), so news hits come back in the same `results[]` shape with direct publisher links.
- `serply_scholar` - Google Scholar, `GET /v1/scholar`. Returns papers under `articles[]` (`title`, `link`, `author`, `description`).

**Parameters**:
- `q` accepts Google operators: `site:`, `-site:`, `filetype:`, `inurl:`, `intitle:"..."`, quoted phrases.
- `num` is an upper bound, capped at 10 per request by Serply. At 10 the row count follows the Google page and can be 9 or 11.
- `gl` is a two-letter country code (`us`, `gb`, `de`). Leave it unset and the region is whatever Google assigns the request, so set it when locality matters.
- `tbs` restricts recency on web and news: `qdr:h` (hour), `qdr:d` (day), `qdr:w` (week), `qdr:m` (month), `qdr:y` (year). Custom date ranges are not supported.

**Result shape**: each hit carries a URL, title and snippet. Snippets are previews; for exact values on a page, fetch the result `link` separately. This connector does not extract page content.

**Pricing**: one credit per request. Docs: https://serply.io/docs

tools.name: serply_search
tools.description: Google web search via Serply. Use when the agent needs current information, documentation, or facts not in its training data. Organic hits are in results[] (title, link, description). Supports Google operators in q: site:, -site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:.

q.description: Search query. Supports site:, -site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:"..." and quoted phrases.

num.description: Max results, 1-10. Serply caps a request at 10.

gl.description: Two-letter country code to localise results (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de').

tools.name: serply_news
tools.description: Google News search via Serply. Calls the same GET /v1/search endpoint as serply_search with Google's news vertical, so hits come back in the same results[] shape with direct publisher links. Use when the user wants news coverage of a topic, company or event rather than general web results.

q.description: News search query. Supports the same operators as serply_search.

gl.description: Two-letter country code to localise results (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de').

tools.name: serply_scholar
tools.description: Google Scholar search via Serply. Returns academic papers in articles[] (title, link, author, description). Use when the user asks for papers, citations or research on a topic rather than general web pages.

q.description: Scholar query, e.g. a topic, a paper title in quotes, or author:"name".
